info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Mergers and Acquisitions Insight API
info.description: The Mergers and Acquisitions Insight API provides access to detailed information regarding corporate finance transactions. This endpoint allows users to retrieve specific data related to mergers and acquisitions, which is crucial for financial analysts, investment bankers, and strategic planners. By examining transaction details, users can evaluate potential opportunities and risks associated with corporate mergers. Typical consumers include finance professionals and organizations looking to gain insights into market trends and deal structures.

get.summary: Retrieve details for a specific merger or acquisition.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific merger or acquisition identified by its unique ID. Use this to access relevant financial data, transaction history, and other pertinent details that are crucial for analysis and decision-making.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information regarding the specified mergers and acquisitions operation. It should contain the necessary parameters required for the operation to be executed appropriately.
